description: This Python source file implements a class `UnifiedLLMGuardrails` which provides various hooks for integrating guardrail logic into LLM API call workflows. It includes methods for pre-call, post-call, moderation, and streaming hooks, specifically designed to interact with the LiteLLM framework and guardrail policies. The class leverages other modules for logging, caching, route-to-call-type mappings, and guardrail processing.
